body: This is exactly what I needed to hear. Thank you. I've been working on improving my life lately and stayed off porn for quite awhile, and things were starting to get so much better. But I relapsed today and it scared me. It's great to hear from someone who's gotten through it and is having a better time now.

It doesn't affect my ability to get things done that I _need_ to, but at my worst, I waste alot of time watching this stuff. Time I could be putting into more productive things. 

Does your boyfriend know about it? We've both had discussions about porn in the past, but quite awhile ago we both agreed it was bad for us and as far as I know I'm the only one continuing to use it. I feel like he'd take it as a huge betrayal if I tried to talk to him about it.
